limitations: No fitting, no held-out features or feedback, no expert truth or model selection.
Profiles reuse clustering inputs: descriptive interpretation, not independent semantic validation.
Positive fraction means feature > 0, not risk severity or an expert label.
Best-Jaccard matching excludes noise and is independent per anchor, not one-to-one label alignment.
Noise is not a semantic cluster; its prototype is intentionally absent.
Map control evidence is not observed red/green light or stop causality.
Prototype minimizes squared distance to mean in globally standardized original features, not UMAP.
Dataset text is context only, not proof of ego interaction. No media was opened or generated.
